malnutrition with low protein, or dilution by IV fluids. Follow-on diagnostics would be pre-albumin and blood 
urea nitrogen.

decrease or prevent malnutrition and obesity. Healthy body weight will help preserve muscle strength and 
help maintain the integrity of the immune system.
